Get groups from SEStats

Source: R/jam_sestats_methods.R
groups-SEStats-method.Rd

Extract group names from the SEStats object's sedesign.

Usage

## S7 method for class <SEStats>
groups(object)

Arguments

x

An SEStats object

Value

Character vector of group names

Details

This is a read-only accessor that retrieves the group names from the SEDesign object stored in the SEStats object.

See also

Other SEStats objects: SEStats(), contrast_names,SEStats-method, factors,SEStats-method, print,SEStats-method, samples,SEStats-method
